headline: PIB cultural de México creció 1.7%, pero la industria audiovisual cayó 6.7%
summary: Mexico's cultural activity contributed 913,088 million pesos in 2025, or 2.72% of GDP, growing faster than the wider economy. The audiovisual industry, however, fell 6.7%.
why: Gross domestic product data show how individual sectors contribute to national output. Sector-level declines can signal shifts in media and entertainment investment.
